tasks.title: Tighten Public Home Schedule Data
tasks.description: Make the existing home flow a reliable public schedule slice. Keep MVC controllers thin while shaping competition rows through the service/repository path, sort public fixtures in natural date-and-time order, and keep unplayed matches from rendering fake official scores.
acceptance_criteria: Guests can open the public home schedule through MVC without entering private team, prediction or admin mutation flows.
Home schedule rows are backed by persisted competition data through the service layer and include countries, date, time, stadium and location context for Thymeleaf rendering.
Public home competitions are ordered chronologically by date and time rather than arbitrary repository order.
The home view only renders official score output when result values are available so unplayed matches stay visibly honest.

tasks.title: Complete Public Match Detail Surface
tasks.description: Complete the public match-detail surface before adding error plumbing. Keep `/competition/{id}` guest-readable through the MVC/service/repository boundary, render only public fixture and official result context for the selected match, and remove private or admin-only detail content from the public screen.
acceptance_criteria: Guests can open a public competition detail page for an existing match through `/competition/{id}`.
The detail screen receives its selected competition data through the controller-to-service boundary rather than direct view or controller repository access.
The public detail screen shows fixture context and official result values only where they belong for the selected competition.
Guest-facing competition detail does not expose private prediction content or public admin mutation controls.

tasks.title: Handle Public Match Detail Errors
tasks.description: Add school-style MVC error behavior for public match detail browsing. Handle missing competition ids and malformed path variables through shared controller advice and existing error-page direction so public browse failures do not surface raw framework errors.
acceptance_criteria: A missing public competition id maps to friendly MVC not-found behavior using the existing error-page direction.
An invalid public match detail path variable is handled as type mismatch behavior rather than a raw framework error.
Shared MVC error handling is used for the public detail error cases instead of scattering error logic through Thymeleaf views.
The task stays on MVC error handling and does not add REST error response or WebClient work.

tasks.title: Harden Public Top-10 Ranking Summary
tasks.description: Make the ranking route a dependable public summary slice. Keep ranking data in the service/repository flow, order teams by their score source, limit output to the top 10, and render only the assignment-required summary columns in Thymeleaf.
acceptance_criteria: Guests can open the public ranking and receive ranking rows backed by real team data from the service and repository path.
Public ranking contains at most 10 teams sorted from highest to lowest total team score.
Each public ranking row exposes team name, total score and member count from backend team data.
The public ranking does not expose invite codes, private member score breakdowns or user-owned team workflow actions.
Ranking score ordering is driven from the team score boundary rather than duplicated ranking calculations inside Thymeleaf.

tasks.title: Finish Public Navigation And i18n Screen
tasks.description: Round out the public shell for home, ranking and match detail. Keep public links discoverable for guests, preserve role-aware links into user/admin work, and move the selected full public screen copy and labels into the resource bundle with the project date-format direction.
acceptance_criteria: Guest navigation reaches public home, public ranking, login and registration without exposing private or admin-only mutation actions.
Authenticated USER navigation still leads toward team and prediction flows while ADMIN navigation still exposes match-management entry points only.
At least one public screen has its visible title, explanatory copy and table or field labels backed by keys in `src/main/resources/i18n/messages.properties`.
Public date presentation for the selected i18n screen follows the project message/date-format direction where it applies.
Navigation and public screen updates remain compatible with the access-and-roles route boundaries already in the project.

tasks.title: Add Public MVC And Security Closure Tests
tasks.description: Close the public homepage and ranking feature with focused school-required verification. Add MVC model/view and error assertions for home, ranking and public match detail together with security checks that keep these screens guest-readable without mixing REST or e2e work into this feature.
acceptance_criteria: MVC controller tests verify home returns the public schedule view and expected competition model data.
MVC controller tests verify ranking behavior is limited to top-10 score order and renders the public summary contract required by the view.
MVC tests cover successful public match detail plus friendly not-found or type-mismatch behavior for invalid public detail URLs.
Security tests verify guests can access public home, ranking and competition detail routes.
Tests use status, view, model and error assertions instead of brittle pixel-level checks.
This task does not add REST controller, WebClient or e2e test work to the public MVC feature.
